# git-branch-cli

Colorized CLI for git branch management.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `list` | List branches sorted by age/newest/name |
| `stale` | Find branches older than N days |
| `merged` | List/delete branches merged into target |
| `compare` | Compare two branches (commits, files, diff) |
| `prune` | Prune stale remote-tracking branches |

## Usage

```bash
# List branches
node bin/git-branch-cli.js list --sort newest -l 10

# Find stale branches (>60 days)
node bin/git-branch-cli.js stale --days 60

# List merged branches (dry-run)
node bin/git-branch-cli.js merged --target main

# Delete merged branches
node bin/git-branch-cli.js merged --target main --delete

# Compare branches
node bin/git-branch-cli.js compare feature/login develop

# Include remote branches
node bin/git-branch-cli.js list --remote

# Prune stale remotes
node bin/git-branch-cli.js prune
```

content.text:
Done. Here's what I built:

**`git-branch-cli/`** — a zero-dependency Node.js CLI for git branch management with colorized output.

**Commands:**
- **`list`** — branches sorted by age/newest/name, with age-based coloring (green < 30d, yellow < 90d, red 90d+)
- **`stale`** — find branches older than N days (default 30)
- **`merged`** — list branches merged into a target; supports `--delete` (dry-run by default)
- **`compare`** — diff two branches (commits, changed files, diff stats)
- **`prune`** — clean up stale remote-tracking branches

All commands support `--remote` for remote branches. No external deps — just Node.js and git.
